items.title: AI-driven development lifecycle using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Engineering teams adopting the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC) often struggle to turn concepts into working code. This post walks through two reference implementations on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Kiro, and Claude Code: an SQL-to-ER-diagram generator and a multi-agent code security analyzer that put the AI-DLC construction phase into practice.

items.title: Migrate agentic workloads to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: An agent that works in a notebook is not an agent in production. This post walks through migrating a LangGraph customer support agent to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore in two stages: onto Runtime, Gateway, and Memory, then to model-driven planning on Strands Agents, retiring operational burdens along the way.

items.title: Integrating Outlook with Amazon Quick for AI-powered email automation
items.summary: Integrate Microsoft Outlook with Amazon Quick to automate email management, calendar scheduling, and workflow coordination. This post walks through the end-to-end setup and shows automation scenarios using Amazon Quick chat agents, Amazon Quick Flows, and Amazon Quick Automate.

items.title: Set up OpenAI ChatGPT Codex with LiteLLM on Amazon ECS and Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Deploy a customer-operated LiteLLM gateway on Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate, connect it to an OpenAI model on Amazon Bedrock, and configure Codex to route requests through the gateway’s Responses API with scoped identities, budgets, rate limits, and telemetry. We also compare direct IAM Identity Center access and a managed Portkey deployment.

items.title: Best practices for building agentic automations with Amazon Quick Automate
items.summary: Learn best practices for building production-grade, agent-based business process automations with Amazon Quick Automate: choosing the right process, designing focused agents, combining them with deterministic steps, applying human-in-the-loop review, and building in evaluation and observability.

items.title: Embed Quick Sight visuals using Cognito user authentication
items.summary: Learn how to embed individual Amazon Quick Sight visuals into a React application with per-user access control. This walkthrough uses Amazon Cognito authentication and a serverless AWS Lambda backend to generate scoped embed URLs, deployed with a single AWS CloudFormation stack.

items.title: Accessing OpenAI models on Amazon Bedrock from Australia with global cross-Region inference
items.summary: Australian teams can now access OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna models on Amazon Bedrock with global cross-Region inference from the Asia Pacific (Sydney) and Asia Pacific (Melbourne) Regions. This post shows how to invoke the models, use prompt caching, set up Codex with OpenID Connect authentication, and monitor usage with Amazon CloudWatch.

items.title: Modernizing and scaling support operations with generative AI on AWS
items.summary: Learn how to build a generative AI-based support operations platform on AWS that converts training videos into structured SOPs, applies Retrieval-Augmented Generation to guide ticket resolution, and uses machine learning to predict SLA risk and prioritize work.

items.title: How an AWS team detects dashboard content failures at scale using Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Business intelligence dashboards can fail silently, showing blank, stale, or wrong data even when every infrastructure monitor reports healthy. Learn how an AWS team built an automated, AI-powered content validation solution on Amazon Bedrock that scans hundreds of dashboards and alerts owners, cutting mean time to detection from days to under an hour.

items.title: From code to diagrams: Agentic architecture documentation with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Learn how a global interdealer broker built an automated architecture documentation pipeline on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that analyzes .NET code bases, generates architecture diagrams, and maintains searchable documentation through Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases and AWS CodePipeline.
